WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_readings AS (
    SELECT
        (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
            ELSE daily_power
        END AS daily_power
    FROM
        user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 606
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),
daily_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        ds.date,
        CASE
            WHEN dr1.daily_power IS NOT NULL AND dr1.daily_power > 0 THEN dr1.daily_power
            ELSE NULL
        END AS daily_consumption
    FROM
        date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN 
        daily_readings dr1 ON ds.date = dr1.date
)
SELECT
    date,
    SUM(daily_consumption) AS "Blower1"
FROM
    daily_consumption
WHERE
    date >= (CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date 
    AND date < (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
GROUP BY
    date
ORDER BY
    date;

daily_chem AS (
    SELECT
        c.date,
        c.chemical_name,
        c.consumption
    FROM user_chemicalstocktrackerdata c
    JOIN user_customform f ON c.form_id = f.id
    WHERE
        f.team_id = 219
        AND $__timeFilter(c.date)
)
SELECT
    ds.date AS "time",
    COALESCE(dc.consumption, 0) AS "value",
    dc.chemical_name AS "metric"
FROM date_series ds
JOIN daily_chem dc ON ds.date = dc.date
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(ds.date)
    AND ds.date >= (CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
    AND ds.date <= (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
ORDER BY ds.date ASC, dc.chemical_name ASC;

WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',  
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',    
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_flow AS (
    SELECT
        (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
            ELSE daily_flow
        END AS flow_in
    FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 465
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),
daily_power AS (
    SELECT
        (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
            ELSE daily_power
        END AS torrent_power
    FROM user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 598
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
)
SELECT
    ds.date AS "time",
    (dp.torrent_power / NULLIF(df.flow_in, 0)) AS "Daily Power Intensity (kWh/m³)"
FROM date_series ds
LEFT JOIN daily_flow df ON ds.date = df.date
LEFT JOIN daily_power dp ON ds.date = dp.date
WHERE
    ds.date >= (CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
    AND ds.date <= (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
ORDER BY ds.date ASC;

WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',  
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',    
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_sludge AS (
    SELECT
        s.date,
        s.daily_sludge_cake
    FROM user_sludgecaketrackerdata s
    JOIN user_customform f ON s.form_id = f.id
    WHERE
        f.team_id = 219
        AND $__timeFilter(s.date)
)
SELECT
    ds.date AS "time",
    COALESCE(dsl.daily_sludge_cake, 0) AS "Sludge Cake Produced (MT)"
FROM date_series ds
LEFT JOIN daily_sludge dsl ON ds.date = dsl.date
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(ds.date)
    AND ds.date >= (CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
    AND ds.date <= (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
ORDER BY ds.date ASC;
